+ ABOUT / THE PERSON BEHIND THE HANDLE

Raahil Muhammad
Wildan.

A penetration tester, bug hunter, and builder of security automation. Online, I go by raahilmw.

I’m interested in how systems behave at their edges: the assumptions in a request, the trust placed in a URL, and the details that change what a feature can do.

My work connects hands-on investigation with engineering. I explore application behavior, document what can be reproduced, and build workflows around the repeatable parts.

This notebook brings those threads together: research worth sharing, experiments worth building, and questions worth following.
